All bodies are single-expression returns using only allowed builtins (any, range) and the documented grid-scan pattern with 'cell is not None' guards before attribute reads. blocker_moved reads the current observation: it locates the door and checks the cell on the start side (left of the door, consistent with the start room holding the ball and key and the box being in the right room); it is false while the ball sits there, true when the cell is empty (including when the ball is carried, since a carried ball leaves the cell empty), and false again if the ball is dropped back on that cell. has_door_key reads env.carrying and matches the carried key's color to the door's color. door_open reads is_open on the guarded door cell. target_picked_up reads env.carrying and matches the carried box's color against env.mission's 'pick up the <color> box' format.
